Reviewed report `aaafb8b4-ce0b-4170-b69a-a8124a87709d` against the original intake and the current source associated with [PR #2651](https://github.com/tailscale-signin/GPT_Mobile_AI-improved/pull/2651), published revision `74ba873cad202e7a99d5fa0681fc75a75b334614`.

The caller returns this configuration error before optional search-tool preparation. Confirmed the relevant guard/caller source matches the captured revision. Executed **14 focused exact-source host cases**, all passing, including the unchanged [explicit-disablement regression](https://github.com/tailscale-signin/GPT_Mobile_AI-improved/blob/74ba873cad202e7a99d5fa0681fc75a75b334614/app/src/test/kotlin/dev/chungjungsoo/gptmobile/data/repository/AppAssistedSearchTest.kt) for chat-only, profile-only, and both-disabled settings, with no permission bypass or remote acceptance.

**Recovery:** Open the selected **AI profile → Tools**, review and enable the tools you intend to authorize, then submit the search again. If tools were deliberately disabled, retain that choice and revise the request to avoid web search. The app must not silently select a different profile, connection, or engine.

**Disposition:** Closing this report after validating the configuration guard and actionable recovery guidance; no app defect was reproduced. This was a local admission decision, not a dispatched OpenRouter request. No profile setting or permission was changed by this audit. The host qualification does not establish a later successful search, and adjacent DNS/context events do not prove the cause of this profile setting.

Also reviewed the existing [missing-source cache regression](https://github.com/tailscale-signin/GPT_Mobile_AI-improved/blob/74ba873cad202e7a99d5fa0681fc75a75b334614/app/src/test/kotlin/dev/chungjungsoo/gptmobile/data/agent/tool/ReadUrlToolTest.kt), which distinguishes cached suppression from another dispatched request and permits a different source.

**Recovery:** Inspect the saved URL, correct a stale or missing path, or select another authorized source.
